blocks.en:
We present the inter-annotator agreements of the human raters based on Krippendorff’s alpha [ 78 , 23 ] using the interval difference function.
The results of the four economics tasks presented in Table 7 show, in some cases, considerable differences in the agreement for the same criteria across different tasks.
Good agreement, with alpha values over 0.8 [ 21 , 8 ] is only achieved for the FILTER criterion in case of the two economics tasks Wind park and Startup .
For task Nudging , the agreement is only tentatively acceptable, with a value of 0.68.
Similarly, the criterion SUM_SCORE in tasks Wind park and Pilot strike are placed within the same agreement range.
The inter-annotator agreement for the other criteria can be considered unreliable, with values well below 0.5 in multiple cases.
This is particularly evident for CONCLUSION in task Nudging , for which the alpha value is close to 0 and thus only slightly above the level of chance.
blocks.zh:
我们以Krippendorff的α[78,23] 使用间隔差函数,提出人类评分员之间的协议。
表7所列四项经济任务的结果显示,在某些情况下,在不同任务中,就同一标准达成的协议存在相当大的差异。
良好一致,α值大于0.8 [21, 8] 只在两个经济学任务中达到FILTER标准 风景公园与创业.
对于任务缓冲,协议只是暂时可以接受,价值为0.68.
同样,任务中的SUM_SCORE标准"风公园"和"飞行员罢工"被置于同一协议范围内.
其他标准的注释者间协议可以被认为是不可靠的,在多种情况下,数值远低于0.5.
这在任务增殖中尤其明显,因为α值接近0,因此略高于机会水平。

blocks.en:
We report unanimous rating agreement as an additional metric.
In the event of highly skewed rating distributions, a low IAA may result from disagreement over a small number of instances of under-represented values, which can have a strong impact on the agreement score.
This is visible for the FILTER criterion in Pilot strike :
here we see an unanimous rating in 93% of the responses, but an IAA alpha of only 0.15.

在这里,我们看到93%的答复得到一致评价,但IAAα只有0.15.

The intraclass correlation coefficients ICC(3,k) range from 0.586 to 0.957, indicating mostly good to excellent inter-rater reliability [ 123 , 29 , 134 ] .
The ICC results generally align with the Krippendorff’s alpha agreements.
Similarly, Cronbach’s alpha (calculated using the listwise deletion method) estimates internal item consistency ranging from poor to excellent, with values from 0.35 to 0.953 [ 34 , 51 , 134 ] .

blocks.en:
These measurements emphasise the challenges involved in rating the economics tasks based on the presented criteria.
In our analysis, we acknowledge that these human ratings differ and that no consolidated gold-standard annotation was provided as part of the original assessment data.
We therefore evaluate the LLM-based ratings in this multi-rater setting without assuming or constructing a single gold-standard annotation.
Instead, each human rating is treated as an equally plausible reference annotation, and the LLM is evaluated by the agreement between the individual raters in the rater group rather than against a single gold label.

这些衡量方法强调在根据所提出的标准对经济学任务进行评级方面的挑战。
在我们的分析中,我们承认这些人类的评级不同,没有作为原始评估数据的一部分提供金标准综合说明。
因此,我们在这种多评分的设定中评价基于LLM的评分,而不假设或构建一个单一的金标准注释.
相反,每个人类评分被作为同样可信的参考注释对待,LLM由评分组中个别评分者之间的协议而不是一个单一的金牌来评价.

blocks.en:
Looking at the three groups of criteria, in the first group of formal criteria, we notice extremely low human rater agreement on the CONCLUSION criterion in the Nudging task.
In contrast, the other two criteria display the highest agreement values.
This suggests a difficulty or misunderstanding regarding what qualifies as a conclusion in the context of the task.
This appears to be a consequence of the ratings performed by rater B.
However, this seems to be specific to this task, as the other three tasks show agreement values comparable with the other criteria.
This task-difference is also evident for the REFERENCE criterion, for which Nudging behaves differently:
agreement is relatively high with 0.648, while the other three tasks display alpha values around 0.24.
In the second group, which contains the structure criteria, no clear distinction in agreement is evident when comparing the different value ranges.
Despite their larger value range, the two non-Boolean criteria exhibit IAA scores in the mid-range.
The IAA among the human raters varies in third category comprising domain knowledge , with the ARGUMENTATION criterion being lower except for the Nudging task.
This could suggest a problem with rater calibration.
Since this criterion accepts only “yes” or “no” as a rating, the raters might use different thresholds when assessing economic argumentation.
Similar to the CONCLUSION criterion, rater B displays different behaviour in task Nudging ; however, this time, the difference appears only in comparison with rater A and not with rater C.
blocks.zh:
审视这三组标准,在第一类正式标准中,我们注意到,在增殖任务中,关于CONCLUSION标准的人类评分协议极低。
与此相反,另外两项标准显示出最高的协议价值。
这表明,在任务中哪些结论可以算作结论的问题上存在困难或误解。
这似乎是由评分员B评级的结果。
然而,这似乎是具体针对这项任务的,因为其他三项任务显示出与其他标准类似的协议价值。
这种任务偏差对于参考标准也很明显,Nudging对此行为不同:
协议相对较高的是0.648,而其他三项任务显示的α值约为0.24.
在包含结构标准的第二组中,在比较不同的价值范围时,协议中没有明确的区分.
尽管其数值范围较大,但两个非波莱语标准在中程显示IAA分数.
人类评估者中的IAA在由域知识组成的第三类中各有不同,除Nudging任务外,ArGUMENTION标准较低.
这可能表明在校准率方面存在问题。
由于这一标准只接受“是”或“否”作为评级,因此,评级人在评估经济论证时可能使用不同的阈值。
与CONCLUSION标准类似,测报员B在任务Nudging中表现出不同的行为;然而,这次的区别只出现在与测报员A的比较中,而不是与测报员C的比较中.

blocks.en:
In the pairwise Krippendorff’s alpha inter-annotator agreements between the human raters we observe that the SUM_SCORE results are stable despite the varying outcomes of the other criteria.
For the other criteria, we notice low agreements e.g., with rater B in task Nudging or rater A in Startup .
This suggests that there are systematic differences in evaluation rather than random variation.
This finding shows that, although the raters disagree on multiple criteria, the composite score can compensate for differences in how the human raters understand, evaluate and apply the criteria.
blocks.zh:
在双向 Krippendorff 的阿尔法 通知人之间的协议中,我们观察到SUM... 尽管其他标准的结果不尽相同,但SCORE的结果是稳定的。
关于其他标准,我们注意到低级协议,例如,与任务Nudging B或启动任务A的评分。
这表明评价存在系统性差异,而不是随机变化。
这一调查结果表明,虽然评分者在多种标准上存在分歧,但综合分数可以弥补人类评分者在理解,评价和适用标准方面的差异.

blocks.en:
Human raters tend to disagree on most of the economics criteria, which may suggest that they have different expectations regarding the students’ statements.
The SUM_SCORE , which is composed of the other criteria and can therefore partially compensate for differences and disagreements, shows comparatively high agreement across all four economics tasks.
While still below 0.80 in all cases, the agreement is often higher than that of the other individual criteria.
This implies that the human raters do not fully agree on how to assess students’ responses on the criteria level, but they do agree more on a holistic assessment and can produce reliable overall performance ratings.
Additionally, as indicated by Cronbach’s alpha, they mostly rank the criteria similarly.
The SUM_SCORE may therefore be more suitable for assigning a holistic performance level to student responses.
Future work should study the direct generation of such a score by LLMs in comparison with a calculated SUM_SCORE .
blocks.zh:
人类评分者往往对大多数经济学标准持不同意见,这可能表明他们对学生的言论有不同的期望。
SUM_SCORE 由其他标准组成,因此可以部分地弥补分歧和分歧,在所有四项经济学任务中显示出相对较高的一致.
虽然在所有情况下,协议仍然低于0.80,但往往高于其他个别标准。
这意味着人类评分者并不完全同意如何评估学生在标准层面的反应,但他们确实更同意整体评估,并能产生可靠的整体业绩评分.
此外,正如Cronbach的alpha所指出的,他们大多对标准进行类似的排序。
因此,SUM_SCORE可能更适合为学生的反应分配一个整体的绩效水平.
未来工作应研究由法学硕士直接产生这种分数与计算出的SUM_ 萨雷.

blocks.en:
Compared with these results, the inter-annotator agreements for the medical tasks criteria show similar tendencies (see Table 8 ).
We observe comparable SUM_SCORE agreement values, which demonstrates the practicality of this holistic criterion across domains.
Similarly to the IAA patterns across the economics criteria, we do not see any systematic behaviour in agreement across the three groups of medical criteria.
The agreement for comparable criteria varies per task; overall, this pattern is similar across the two domains.
blocks.zh:
与这些结果相比,关于医疗任务标准的公证员协议也显示出类似的倾向(见表8)。
我们观察到可比较的SUM_SCORE协议值,这表明这一整体标准在各个领域的实用性。
与跨经济学标准的国际影响评估模式类似,我们不认为这三类医疗标准有任何一致的系统行为。
关于可比标准的协议因任务而异;总的来说,这两个领域的情况相似。

blocks.en:
Together, the inter-annotator agreements across the eight tasks highlight the challenge of manual annotation when assessing student writing:
in both domains, ratings range from low to good, depending on the task and criterion, with a larger share of criteria reaching at least tentatively acceptable agreement in medicine (32 of 72) than in economics (5 of 31).
We use these results to set the baseline for model-based annotation, analysing to what extent LLMs can replace individual human raters while maintaining the level of agreement among the raters (RQ1).
In other words, given these divergent inter-annotator agreements, how effectively can LLMs replace one or two human raters in this rating task?
Maintaining the agreement does not necessarily mean that the assessment is correct:
if the LLM provided a more accurate rating than human raters, agreement would decrease.
However, our aim is to verify whether an LLM can replace a rater in this context based on these human results and similar instructions and information.
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup
在这两个领域,评级从低到好,取决于任务和标准,在标准中,在医学方面至少达成初步可接受的一致的比例(72分之32)大于经济学(31分之5)。
我们利用这些结果确定基于模型的注释的基准,分析有限责任公司在多大程度上可以取代个人评分,同时保持评分者之间的一致程度(RQ1)。
换句话说,鉴于这些不同通知人之间的协议,有限责任公司在这项评级任务中如何能够有效地取代一两个人的评级人?
维持协议并不一定意味着评估是正确的:
如果LLM提供比人评分更准确的评分,那么协议就会减少.
然而,我们的目标是根据这些人类成果以及类似的指示和信息,核实一个LLM能否取代在这方面的检测器。

blocks.en:
We demonstrate the effects of replacing one of the human raters with an LLM-generated rating for the 103 criteria across all eight tasks covered in the main study  in Figure 4 .
The boxplots show the change in inter-annotator agreement among the LLM–human rater groups after each human rater has been replaced by each LLM one by one.
While the overall average across all tested combinations is predominantly negative, we observe improvements in IAA for at least one LLM–human combination for most criteria, except for the FILTER criterion.
There, we do not see any variance:
the prompts and models behave very similarly and achieve a positive change only for the Pilot strike task.
However as mentioned in subsection 4.1 , the FILTER criterion displays a highly skewed distribution towards the “yes” option, and small deviations in the minority option result in higher disagreement.
We notice an improvement for the REFERENCE criterion in the three tasks except Nudging , which confirms that it is more difficult to achieve improvements in agreement when the human raters already display high levels of agreement.
Compared to the economics tasks, the medicine tasks show a wider distribution of agreement changes for most criteria.
These findings show that we can build LLM–prompt configurations that can replace one human rater for most criteria under our agreement-based evaluation.
In total, this is the case for 86.4% of the criteria (89 of 103).
These criteria show increased agreement among human raters and LLMs in at least one case when one human rater is replaced with an LLM.
blocks.zh:
我们在图4主要研究涵盖的所有八项任务中,用103项标准LLM生成的评分取代其中一项人类评分的效果。
盒片显示在LLM-人类评分器组中,
虽然所有测试组合的总平均值主要是负值,但我们注意到,除了FILTER标准外,大多数标准中至少有一种LLM-人类组合在IAA中有所改进。
我们没有看到任何差异:
这些提示和模型的行为非常相似,并且只为"飞行员"的罢工任务而实现积极的改变.
然而,如第4.1分节所述,FILTER标准显示,对“是”选项的分布高度偏差,少数选项的微小偏差导致更大的分歧。
我们注意到,除了Nudging之外,在三项任务中参考性标准有所改进,这证实,在人们已经表现出高度一致的情况下,协议的改善就更加困难了。
与经济学任务相比,医药任务显示大多数标准协议变更分布较广.
这些调查结果表明,我们可以构建LLM-即时配置,以取代我们基于协议的评估中大多数标准的人类评分器。
总共有86.4%的标准(103个标准中的89个标准)属于这种情况。
这些标准表明,在至少一个案例中,如果将一个人类评分器替换为最低限值,则人类评分器和LLMs之间更加一致。

blocks.en:
The results of the second experiment, the Nudging-only study, are shown in Figure 5 .
Generally, we observe similar distributions across the different human raters, which is expected, since the prompts in both experiments are based on similar variants.
However, whereas six of the eight criteria displayed a positive change in inter-annotator agreement, we now see an improvement in all eight criteria of the Nudging task, including the FILTER .
Based on the results of this experiment, we are able to replace a human rater for 91 of the 103 criteria (88.3%).
We contrast these results with the Alternative Annotator Test in the next section.
blocks.zh:
第二次试验的结果,即 " 裸体研究 " ,见图5。
一般来说,我们观测到不同人类测评器之间的类似分布,这是预料之中的,因为两个实验中的提示都是基于相似的变体.
然而,尽管8项标准中有6项在通知人之间的协议方面出现了积极的变化,但我们现在看到,包括FILTER在内的所有8项标准都有所改善。
根据这项试验的结果,我们可以替换103项标准中的91项(88.3%)的人的评分标准。
我们将这些结果与下一节的“备选注释者试验”作了对比。

blocks.en:
The prompts considered so far work by asking the model for all criteria in a single request or through chained messages.
As part of the Nudging-only study, we additionally examine LLM and prompt configurations that focus on COHERENCE and ARGUMENTS_COUNT .
Here, we observe no positive change in IAA for the prompts concerning the ARGUMENTS_COUNT criterion.
Compared to the non-specialised prompts, the agreement alpha increases slightly to a new maximum value for the COHERENCE criterion.
Based on this test, it cannot be inferred whether the LLMs are able to produce more agreeable ratings when prompted to consider all criteria simultaneously rather than to separately.
blocks.zh:
迄今考虑的提示是,在单一请求中或通过连锁电文要求所有标准采用模式。
作为"努丁唯研究"的一部分,我们额外研究了LLM和即时配置,这些配置侧重于协调与ArGUMENDS_COUNT.
在此,我们发现《国际仲裁裁决汇编》没有就关于AGUMENDS_COUNT标准的提示作出积极的变化。
与非专用的提示相比,协议alpha对COHERENCE标准略微提升到一个新的最大值.
根据这项检验标准,不能推断有限责任公司是否能够在被要求同时考虑所有标准而不是单独考虑时产生更令人满意的评级。

blocks.en:
Tables 9 to 17 in the appendix provide an overview of the top IAA values and models per task.
The tables show the highest IAA score as well as the change per criterion when replacing a human rater with an LLM.
The list is sorted by the top IAA score and subsequently by the largest positive IAA change.
The count ( # ) indicates the number of models achieving the same IAA value; the models are sorted alphabetically.
blocks.zh:
附录中的表9至表17概述了每项任务的最高IAA值和模型.
这些表格显示了最高的IAA分数,以及用LLM取代人评分器时每个标准的变化.
列表按IAA最高得分排序,随后按最大正数IAA变化排序.
计数(#)表示实现相同IAA值的模型数量;这些模型按字母排序.

blocks.en:
For economics, we report prompts from four of the five categories as the top-performing prompts per criterion in the main study, only the OPT category is missing.
A PE2 -optimised prompt is top-performing in the Nudging-only study  for the SPECIFIC_ARGUMENTS criterion, and a few-shot prompt outperforms the prompts for the COHERENCE criterion.
We do not observe the economics-fine-tuned LLM Plutus among the actual top results for the economics criteria, with the exception of FILTER ; however, in this case, the top position is shared with about 50 other configurations, and the change is negative.
Plutus is also shown as top-performing for the medical Circulation task on B7 , this criterion displays a drop from perfect agreement among the human raters to an IAA of 0, and this top position is also shared with three other configurations.
The medical LLM similarly appears only in one negative case.
These findings suggest that, in the context of this study, using more specialised LLMs offers no apparent advantage.
blocks.zh:
就经济学而言,我们报告五个类别中四个类别的提示是主要研究中每个标准中表现最好的提示,只有被占领土类别缺失。
PE2 - 最优化的提示是针对Specific_ARGUMENTS 标准的 Nudging 唯一研究中表现最优的提示,几发提示效果超过了对 Coherence 标准的提示.
我们没有观察经济调整LLM Plutus在经济学标准的实际最高结果中,除了FILTER(英语:FILTER)以外;然而,在这种情况下,最高位置与其他约50个配置共享,变化是负的.
Plutus也被显示为B7上的医学环流任务的最高性能,这个标准显示从人类评分者之间的完美一致下降到0的IAA,这个顶位置也与其他三个配置共享.
医疗LLM同样只出现在一个负面病例中.
这些调查结果表明,在这项研究中,使用更专门的有限责任制度没有明显的优势。

blocks.en:
In total, 14.6% (2992 of 20464) of the tested configurations per criterion show no decrease in IAA, 70% of which concern the medical criteria.
Relative to each domain, 12% of the economics samples and 16% of the medical samples pass the human replacement test.
The distribution is similar to that of the total passing criteria, with Nudging in first place (55.87%), where we can replace a human rater with an LLM for all criteria, followed by Startup (19.53% pass, replacement for 87.5% of criteria), Pilot strike (13.32%; 85.7%) and Wind park (11.29%; 75%).
However, the results for the Nudging task may be skewed because of the additional tests in the Nudging-only study.
This pattern is replicated for the medical tasks, where we report Eye (36.70%), Middle ear (25.31%), Circulation (22.41%) and Breathing (15.57%).
These results further confirm a certain degree of task-specific difficulty, which corresponds to the mean human IAA per task: lower human agreement can be matched more easily by the LLMs.
blocks.zh:
总共14.6%(20464人中的2992人)的每个标准测试配置显示,IAA没有下降,其中70%涉及医疗标准.
相对于每个领域,12%的经济样本和16%的医疗样本都通过了人类替代测试.
分布与总通过标准相似,Nudging居第一位(55.87%),我们可以在所有标准中以LLM取代人评分,其次是Startup(19.53%通过,替代87.5%的标准)、Pilot罢工(13.32%;85.7%)和Wind Park(11.29%;75%)。
然而,由于 " 裸体 " 研究中的其他测试, " 裸体 " 任务的结果可能扭曲。
这种模式在医疗任务中被复制,我们报告说,眼(36.70%)、中耳(25.31%)、流通(22.41%)和呼吸(15.57%)。
这些结果进一步证实了特定任务的一定难度,这与人类IAA每任务的平均难度相对应:较低层次的人类协议更容易被LLMs匹配.

blocks.en:
We most frequently report Llama 3.3 (70b) among the top-performing economics configurations in the main study, with 17 occurrences, followed by Nemotron (70b) with 4 occurrences.
The most frequent prompt classes are TRAINING (10), CHAIN (9), SIMPLE (6) and FEATURES (4).
GPT-OSS (120b) achieves top performance for 14 medical criteria.
However, as in economics, Llama 3.3 (70b) performs best overall, with 31 occurrences, with Nemotron (70b) in third place with 10 occurrences.
For the medicine tasks, the distribution of the best prompts shifts to the CHAIN group (37), followed by OPT (24) and FEATURES (7).
Looking at the top performances, we see a variety of LLM families and prompt groups, but with a strong focus on one LLM in both domains and different prompt groups per domain.
blocks.zh:
我们经常报告,在主要研究中,Llama3.3(70b)是表现最好的经济学结构之一,有17种,其次是Nemotron(70b),有4种。
最常见的即时班是培训(10个)、CHAIN(9个)、SIMPLE(6个)和FEATURES(4个)。
GPT-OSS(120b)在14个医疗标准上达到最高性能.
然而,与经济学一样,Llama 3.3(70b)的总体表现最好,有31次,Nemotron(70b)排在第三位,有10次。
就医药任务而言,最好的药品分配将转至CHAIN(37),其次是OPS(24)和FEATURES(7)。
从顶级表演来看,我们看到各种LLM家族和即时团体,但强烈关注两个领域的一个LLM和每个域的不同即时团体.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Heatmap showing model overlap among the top 10 models per domain and criterion.
blocks.zh: 图6:热图显示每个域和标准前10个模型的模型重叠.

blocks.en:
The results so far consider only the top-performing configurations.
We show the ranking of the top 10 LLM–prompt configurations per domain and criterion in Figure 6 , and their Jaccard similarity in the appendix in Figure 23 .
We report an average of similarity of 0.36 and, for FILTER , full overlap.
Two clusters can be observed, generally containing only medical and economics criteria, respectively.
Overall, we see the GPT-OSS models of both sizes perform best, using the prompt optimized by Opus – this is however skewed by the larger number of medicine criteria.
Ranking the prompts by domain separately, we see TRAINING prompts rank highly for the economics criteria, and CHAIN prompts rank highly for medicine.
The larger number of medical criteria could benefit from more fine-grained, criterion-by-criterion rating generation.
However, as with economics, we see instances of all prompt classes among the top performing configurations.
The Jaccard similarities are slightly lower for economics (0.31) and higher for medicine (0.42).
The highest overlap is between the two criteria ARGUMENTATION and SPECIFIC_ARGUMENTS , both placed in the domain knowledge group.
These results suggest that the model does not require specific training per domain or task, but that the prompt is sensitive to both, criteria and task.
blocks.zh:
迄今为止的结果只考虑表现最好的配置。
我们在图6中显示每个域和标准前10名LLM-即时配置的排名,并在图23的附录中显示它们的Jaccard相似性。
我们报告的平均相似度为0.36,而FILTER则完全重叠。
可以观察到两组,一般只包含医学和经济学标准。
总的来说,我们看到两种大小的GPT-OSS模型都表现最好,它们利用了Opus的快速优化 — — 然而,这被更多的药品标准扭曲了。
在分别按领域排序的提示中,我们看到Training提示在经济学标准上名列前茅,CHAIN提示在医学上名列前茅。
更多的医疗标准可以受益于更精细、按标准划分的评级。
然而,与经济学一样,我们看到在业绩最好的组合中出现了所有速成课程。
Jaccard的相似性在经济学(0.31)和医学(0.42)方面略低。
最高的重叠是在两个标准(Argumentation)和Specific_Argunes之间,两者都放在域知识组中.
这些结果表明,该模式不需要每个领域或任务的具体培训,而是对标准和任务都敏感。

blocks.en:
Our results so far show that we are able to replace a human rater without lowering the agreement for about 88% of the criteria.
This was evaluated by examining whether any LLM–prompt combination can replace any human rater.
In other words, we consider only peak performance to determine the upper bound of what is possible with the studied configurations.
We confirm our findings by using a second metric in addition to inter-annotator agreement:
We present the results of the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test) [ 20 ] to determine which LLMs and prompts can replace human raters.
See Figures 7 (economics) and 8 (medicine) for an overview of the results of the alt-test, showing the top three models per task.
blocks.zh:
我们迄今的结果显示,我们能够在不降低约88%标准协议的情况下,取代人评分标准。
通过检查任何LLM-即时组合是否能取代任何人类测评器来评价这一点.
换句话说,我们考虑的只是峰值性能,以确定用所研究的配置所能达到的上限.
除了通知人之间的协议之外,我们用第二个标准来确认我们的调查结果:
我们介绍替代注解测试(alt-test)的结果[20],以确定哪些LLMs和提示可以取代人类评分.
参见图7(经济学)和图8(医学),关于备选测试结果的概述,显示每个任务前三名模型.

blocks.en:
In contrast to the inter-annotator metric, we now examine the top LLM–prompt combinations based on the number of criteria for which they pass the alt-test.
In total, we report that 87.4% of the criteria (90 of 103) can be graded using an LLM-based automatic rating according to the alt-test.
This shows that at least one LLM–prompt combination can replace at least 50% of the human annotators for a given criterion.
blocks.zh:
与通知人之间的衡量标准不同,我们现在根据通过备选测试的标准数量来审查LLM-即时组合。
总之,我们报告说,87.4%的标准(103分中的90分)可以按照备选测试使用基于LLM的自动分级.
这表明,至少一个LLM-即时组合可以取代至少50%的人类注释员来进行特定标准.

blocks.en:
We show the effect of the cost-benefit parameter in Figure 24 in the appendix.
Even when considering a value of 0.1, which Calderon et al. [20] recommended for unskilled crowdworkers, we still see most criteria passing.
blocks.zh:
我们在附录图24中显示了成本效益参数的影响。
即使考虑值为0.1, Calderon et al. [20] 推荐给不熟练的人群工作者,我们仍然看到大多数标准通过.

blocks.en:
In total, we report that 41.87%, i.e., 2,423 of the 5,787 evaluated combinations, pass the alt-test.
The passing prompt classes behave differently compared with the IAA-change metric:
we now see prompts from the OPT and FEATURES groups in first and second position with 33% and 24%, respectively, both overall and per domain.
Considering the configurations ranked by number of passing criteria, we again find the TRAINING prompt group at the top for economics, compared with OPT , FEATURES and CHAIN prompts for medicine.
This is more in line with our findings using IAA change as a metric and again highlights the need for domain-specific prompts.
The results of the alt-test suggest the same conclusion as the IAA-change results.
blocks.zh:
总之,我们报告说,41.87%,即5 787种评估组合中的2 423种,通过了备选测试。
与IAA变化衡量标准相比,
现在,我们看到被占领土和FEATURES集团在第一和第二位置的提示,总体和每个领域分别占33%和24%。
考虑到按通过标准的数目排列的配置,我们再次发现,与被占领土、FEATURES和CHAIN的医药提示相比,TrainING即时组在经济学方面名列前茅。
这更符合我们利用《国际审计准则》变化作为衡量标准的调查结果,并再次强调需要针对具体领域的提示。
备选测试的结果表明与IAA变化结果相同的结论.

blocks.en: 4.4 Replacing Two Human Raters
blocks.zh: 4.4 替换两个人类鼠标

blocks.en: Figure 9 : Inter-annotator agreement when replacing two human raters with all LLM–prompt combinations in the medical tasks.
blocks.zh: 图9:在医疗任务中用所有LLM-即时组合取代两个人评分时,通知人之间的协议.

blocks.en: Figure 10 : Inter-annotator agreement when replacing two human raters with all LLM–prompt combinations in the economy tasks.
blocks.zh: 图10:在经济任务中用所有LLM-即时组合取代两个人评分时,通知人之间的协议.

blocks.en:
We have demonstrated that an LLM can replace one of the human raters across all eight tasks.
We further assess the extent to which LLMs can replace two raters in the main study.
Figures 9 (medicine) and 10 (economics) show the resulting inter-annotator agreement for all eight tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们已经证明,一个LLM可以取代所有八项任务中的人的评分。
我们进一步评估在主要研究中,有限责任公司在多大程度上可以取代两个评级人。
图9(医疗)和图10(经济)显示所有八项任务都因此达成通知人之间的协议。

blocks.en:
As expected from existing research, there are fewer differences in the agreement distributions than when only one human rater is replaced.
On average, the top agreement changes are higher for each task, the LLMs tend to agree more among themselves.
In the main study, we observe an improvement of four additional passing criteria, totaling 90.3% of the criteria (93 of 103) with a non-negative IAA change.
Two of these four criteria come from the medical task Middle ear and one each from economics tasks Wind park and Nudging .
The medical task has the highest average number of human raters per student response, while both economics tasks have the lowest, thus leaving only one human rater in the agreement calculation.
However, for both economics tasks, two human raters cannot be replaced for all criteria.
Overall, these results are therefore quite stable.
This suggests that, even in a setting such as the one studied here, a reduced number of human raters may suffice to ground the LLM-based approaches.
blocks.zh:
根据现有研究的预期,协议分配的差异比仅更换一个人评分器时要小。
平均而言,每项任务的顶级协议变化较高,有限责任公司之间往往更一致。
在主要研究中,我们观察到另外四个通过标准有所改进,总共达到标准的90.3%(103分之93),并有非负面的IAA变化.
这四项标准中有两项来自医疗任务Middle ear,
医疗任务平均每个学生响应的人评分数最高,而两个经济学任务都最低,因此协议计算中只留下一个人评分数.
然而,对于两个经济学任务来说,两个人的评分率不能被所有标准所取代.
因此,总的来说,这些结果相当稳定。
这表明,即使在本文所研究的这种环境下,减少的人的评分率可能足以证明基于LLM的方法是正确的。

blocks.en: 4.5 LLM-based Rating
blocks.zh: 4.5 基于LLM的评级

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Results of the IAA-change and alt-test analyses for the 103 criteria considered across all eight tasks.
blocks.zh: 图11:所有八项任务中考虑的103项标准的《国际影响评估》变化和备选测试分析结果。

blocks.en: Figure 12 : LLM–prompt configuration overlap when comparing the top N N performers according to IAA-change and alt-test.
blocks.zh: 图12: LLM–在根据IAA-change和alt-test比较N顶级表演者时,即时配置重叠.

blocks.en:
The two metrics presented in subsection 4.2 and subsection 4.3 are summarised in Figure 11 .
The improvements in the Nudging task over the results of the main study  are shown in yellow.
As the Alternative Annotator Test already shows all criteria passing for this task, this applies only to the inter-annotator agreement metric.
Together, these results address research questions RQ1 and RQ2 :
both metrics point in the same direction and indicate that, for most criteria, at least one LLM–prompt configuration can replace one or even two human raters without lowering the agreement (RQ1); this holds for all eight tasks and both domains, although the share of criteria varies by task and the best configuration differ by task and criterion (RQ2).
We show the LLM–prompt configuration overlap, considering the top N N best performing prompts as determined by the two metrics per task, in Figure 12 .
Considering only the top configuration, we report an overlap with a CHAIN prompt for the two medicine tasks Circulation and Middle ear (Llama 3.3 70b in both cases) and task Nudging (Gemma 2 27b).
At the top 10, we see an average overlap of 21% across all tasks except Wind park , for which overlap appears only at the top 25.
At top 5, only economy tasks Wind park and Startup show no overlap.
These findings support the feasibility of the LLM-rater approach across the eight tasks.
blocks.zh:
图11概述了第4.2分节和第4.3分节提出的两个指标。
与主研究的结果相比,"努丁任务"的改进用黄色表示.
由于替代注释员测试已经显示为完成这项任务而通过的所有标准,这只适用于注释员之间的协议衡量标准。
这些成果共同解决了研究问题RQ1和RQ2:
两种衡量标准都指向同一方向,并表明,对于大多数标准来说,至少有一种LLM-即时配置可以取代一种甚至两种人评分,而不降低协议(RQ1);这对所有8项任务和两个领域都适用,不过标准的比例因任务而异,最佳配置因任务和标准而异(RQ2)。
我们显示 LLM — 即时配置重叠, 考虑每个任务两个度量所决定的N N 顶级最佳性能提示, 如图12。
仅考虑到顶部配置,我们报告与两个药品任务循环和中耳(两种情况下均为Llama 3.3 70b)和Nudging任务(Gemma 2 27b)的CHAIN提示器重叠。
在前10名,我们看到除风公园外的所有任务平均重叠率为21%,其中的重叠只在前25名出现.
在前5名,只有经济任务"风景公园"和"创业"没有出现重叠.
这些结论支持了在八项任务中采用LLM率办法的可行性。

blocks.en: We now investigate the influence of the chosen LLMs and prompts using a SHAP analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们现在调查所选择的有限责任公司的影响,并利用SHAP分析的提示。

blocks.en: 4.6 SHAP Results
blocks.zh: 4.6 SHAP 结果

blocks.en:
We perform a SHAP analysis to determine the feature importance of the LLM–prompt configurations by using two types of proxy models.
The trained proxy models achieve a performance of R 2 = 0.73 R^{2}=0.73 for regression and F 1 = 0.79 F_{1}=0.79 for binary classification.
For comparison, the results of a baseline model and two SVM variants are shown in Table 18 in the appendix.
The SHAP analysis attributes the greatest influence to features related to the LLM parameter size and the number of input and output tokens, as shown in the beeswarm plots in Figure 13 .
That is, larger models tend to result in better replaceability and IAA prediction, with a similar pattern observed for higher numbers of input tokens.
The more variable the number of output tokens is, the lower the performance.
This may indicate problems with prompt stability, as the output should not vary substantially with the student response given.
The Llama 3.3 (70b) model appears in the list of top features with a positive influence on both the IAA value and the IAA change.
This is supported by our analysis of the LLMs, in which this model was the best-performing model most often.
The FILTER criterion shows a mirrored behaviour in the regression and classification models.
This can be explained by the fact that we are able to correctly predict the IAA value, which, as shown in our analysis, mostly does not lead to a positive change.
blocks.zh:
我们进行SHAP分析,通过使用两种代理模型来确定LLM-即时配置的特征重要性.
训练过的代理模型实现回归性能为R 2 = 0.73 R^{2}=0.73,二进制分类为F 1 = 0.79 F_{1}=0.79.
为便于比较,一个基准模型和两个SVM变体的结果载于附录表18。
SHAP分析将最大影响归属于与LLM参数大小以及输入和输出符号数量相关的特征,如图13中的蜂暖地块所示.
也就是说,更大的模型往往能产生更好的可替换性和IAA的预测,同时观察到的输入符数较多的类似模式.
输出符数的变数越多,性能越低.
这可能表明存在迅速稳定的问题,因为产出不应因学生的反应而大相径庭。
Llama 3.3(70b)模型出现在顶部特征列表中,对IAA值和IAA变化都有积极影响.
这一点得到我们对有限责任公司的分析的支持,在这种模型中,这种模型往往是表现最好的模型。
FILTER标准在回归和分类模型中显示了一个反照的行为.
其原因是,我们能够正确预测国际影响评估的价值,正如我们的分析所表明的那样,这种价值大多不会导致积极的变化。

blocks.en: (a) Classifier
blocks.zh: (a) 分类符

blocks.en: (b) Regression
blocks.zh: (b) 倒退

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Beeswarm plots showing feature importance based on the SHAP analysis.
blocks.zh: 图13:基于SHAP分析显示特征重要性的Beswarm地块。

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Grouped feature-importance values according to the SHAP analysis.
blocks.zh: 图14:根据SHAP分析分类的特征重要性值。

blocks.en:
Figure 15 : Comparison of the resulting IAA score after replacing one human rater against the total number of tokens consumed and generated by the LLMs (left) and the number of LLM parameters (right).
Log-scaled x-axis.
blocks.zh:
图15:替换一个人测分器后得出的IAA分数与LLMs(左)消耗和生成的代币总数和LLM参数数(右)的比较.
日志缩放的x轴.

blocks.en:
Overall, the importance of the six feature groups is presented in Figure 14 , where we show the normalized share of the absolute SHAP values per group.
For predicting the IAA values, the rater configuration matters less than for determining whether the change in IAA is non-negative, and the decoding features also do not play a major role.
For both methods, the resource - and task -related groups are the most influential, suggesting that the outcomes are sensitive to the actual task, as well as the prompt and context size.
These groups are more important for the prediction of exact IAA values using the regression model.
By comparison, whether an LLM can replace a human rater, as shown by the classification model, depends more on the LLM model selection, prompt design , and the replaced rater.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,图14列出了这六个特征组的重要性,图14显示了每组绝对SHAP值的正常份额。
对于预测IAA值而言,率子配置的重要性小于确定IAA中的变化是否为非负值,解码功能也不发挥主要作用.
就这两种方法而言,与资源和任务有关的小组是最有影响力的,这表明,结果对实际任务以及迅速和背景大小都敏感。
这些组对使用回归模型预测准确的IAA值更为重要.
相比之下,如分类模型所示,LLM是否能够取代人类的测速器,则更依赖于LLM模型选择,即时设计,以及被替换的测速器.

blocks.en:
The results of the SHAP analysis provide an answer to research question RQ3 and highlight the importance of the task sensitivity.
Within the model-related features, model size appears to be more informative than the concrete model.
To further evaluate this finding, we compare the IAA scores with the total number of tokens and the LLM model size (number of parameters) in Figure 15 .
We report statistically significant ( p ≤ 0.05 p\leq 0.05 ) small to moderate effects using Pearson and Spearman correlations for both variables: token amount ( r = 0.17 r=0.17 , ρ = 0.38 \rho=0.38 ) and model size ( r = 0.23 r=0.23 , ρ = 0.33 \rho=0.33 ).
Both correlations are positive, confirming an increase in IAA with larger token counts and model sizes, as indicated by the SHAP analysis using the proxy model.
However, the effect is not as strong as suggested by SHAP and varies depending on the task.
In addition, the plot also shows high performances for smaller model sizes and token counts.
blocks.zh:
SHAP分析的结果为研究问题RQ3提供了答案,并强调了任务敏感性的重要性.
在与模型有关的特征中,模型尺寸似乎比具体模型更丰富。
为了进一步评价这一结论,我们比较了IAA的分数与符号总数和图15中的LLM模型大小(参数数).
我们利用皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼两个变量的关联性报告统计意义(p 0.05 p\leq 0.05)小到中度效应:符号量(r = 0.17 r= 0.17 r= 0.17 , ρ = 0.38 )和模型大小(r = 0.23 r= 0.23 , ρ = 0.33 ).
两者的关联性都是正的,证实了IAA的增加,代号计数和模型大小更大,如SHAP使用代用模型的分析所示.
然而,效果不如SHAP建议的那样强烈,视任务的不同而有所不同.
此外,该地块还为较小的模型尺寸和符号计数显示高性能.

blocks.en: 4.7 Rating Consistency
blocks.zh: 4.7 评级一致性

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Consistency of LLM ratings based on inter-annotator agreement across five repetitions.
blocks.zh: 图16:LLM评级的一致性,基于5次重复的注释者间协议.

blocks.en:
Figure 16 shows the inter-annotator agreement across the five repeated ratings for the subset of LLM–prompt combinations from the Nudging-only study.
The results show no deviation for the FILTER criterion.
While the other criteria do show outliers with negative agreement, we observe high consistency in their ratings on average.
blocks.zh:
图16显示Nudging只研究的LLM-即时组合子集的5个重复收视率的注释者间一致.
结果显示FILTER标准没有偏差.
虽然其他标准确实有否定的共识,但我们注意到,它们的平均评级高度一致。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Unlike other studies that conclude that LLMs are currently unable to replace human annotators (e.g., [ 120 , 24 , 157 ] ), our results suggest a more promising outlook in line with studies reporting LLM performance matching conventional models (e.g., [ 149 , 31 ] ).
We show that, for most criteria, at least one LLM–prompt configuration can replace an individual human annotator in essay-grading tasks in educational economics and medicine without lowering the agreement among the raters ( RQ1 ).
We demonstrate this for eight tasks across these two domains and per-task rubrics comprising 103 criteria in total ( RQ2 ).
We confirm our finding using two metrics:
(1) inter-annotator agreement based on Krippendorff’s alpha, which shows replaceability based on agreement patterns;
and (2) the Alternative Annotator Test , which provides statistical significance and additionally accounts for the cost of the human annotation.
Our evaluation shows that the agreement is preserved or increased for most criteria when replacing one or two human raters with LLMs, and that multiple LLMs pass the alt-test, meaning they can replace at least 50% of the human raters.
blocks.zh:
与其他研究不同,这些研究的结论是,有限责任公司目前无法取代人的注释员(例如,[120、24、157]),我们的结果表明,报告有限责任公司业绩与常规模型相匹配的研究(例如,[149、31])的前景更为乐观。
我们显示,对于大多数标准来说,至少一个LLM-即时配置可以取代个人在教育经济学和医学的作文分级任务中的个人注释员,而不会降低评分员之间的协议(RQ1).
我们在这两个领域和每个任务主题的8项任务中表明了这一点,这些任务包括总共103项标准(RQ2)。
我们用两个标准来确认我们的结论:
(1) 以Krippendorff的α为基础的通知人之间的协议,这表明根据协议模式可以替换;
和(2)替代注释测试,该测试提供了统计意义,并额外说明人类注释的成本。
我们的评价显示,在用LLMs取代一两个人评分时,大多数标准都保留或增加协议,而多个LLMs通过Alt测试,这意味着它们至少可以替换50%的人评分.

blocks.en:
These are best-case results:
the best configuration differs by task and criterion, and most tested configurations lower the agreement.
Since we compare the LLM ratings with those of the human raters and do not evaluate their absolute quality, a change in agreement does not show whether the LLM-based ratings are better or worse.
An increase may also result from replacing the only rater who rated a response correctly, while a decrease may result from LLM ratings that are more accurate than those of the human raters.
The same applies to the alt-test, which also uses the human raters as the reference.
Instead, we address the question that arises in practice, where gold-standard ratings are rarely available and human raters partly disagree:
whether an LLM can take the place of one of these human raters without lowering their agreement.
blocks.zh:
这些是最佳结果:
最佳配置因任务和标准而异,大多数测试的配置会降低协议.
由于我们比较LLM的收视率和人类评分率的收视率,不评价其绝对质量,协议的改变并不能显示基于LLM的收视率是优是劣.
增加还可能是因为更换了唯一正确评分回复的评分,而LLM评分比人类评分更准确。
这同样适用于alt测试,它也使用人测率作为参考.
相反,我们处理在实践中出现的问题,即黄金标准评级很少,而人的评级者则部分不同意:
是否可以不降低其协议而取代其中一人。

blocks.en:
We rely on real-world data from the original assessment, manually annotated by multiple trained human raters.
Their inter-annotator agreement shows that constructing a single gold label can be challenging (as shown in Table 7 ).
We therefore treat each rater’s score as an equally plausible reference and compare our LLM ratings with those of all human raters:
separately in the case of annotator agreement and combined using the alt-test.
In future work, this rating indeterminacy could additionally be evaluated more explicitly, e.g., following the framework presented by Guerdan et al. [55] .
Although our aim is not to imitate individual raters, the replaced rater matters:
replacing a rater whose ratings deviate from the others can increase agreement ( Figure 4 ), and the SHAP analysis identifies the replaced rater as relevant for whether a non-negative change is achieved ( Figure 13 ).
blocks.zh:
我们依靠来自最初评估的现实世界数据,这些数据由多位受过训练的人的评分员手动注释。
他们的公证员协议表明,建造单一的金牌可能具有挑战性(如表7所示)。
因此,我们把每个评分者评分作为同样可信的参考,并将我们的LLM评分与所有人类评分者的评分进行比较:
在说明人协议的情况下,采用备选测试法合并。
在今后的工作中,这种评级的确定性还可以得到更明确的评价,例如,按照Guerdan等人提出的框架。 [55] (中文(简体) ).
尽管我们的目标不是模仿个人的评分,但被替换的评分很重要:
替换一个评级偏离其他评级的评级者可以增加协议(图4),SHAP分析确定,被替换的评级者与是否实现非负变化相关(图13)。

blocks.en:
While the alt-test shows that LLM–prompt configurations can replace a human rater for all criteria in Nudging and nearly all criteria overall, including SUM_SCORE , the IAA results show that the best agreement is achieved by different LLM–prompt combinations.
Using an ensemble of LLMs therefore maximises their effectiveness.
However, our experiments with criterion-focused prompts for task Nudging , in which the LLM is queried for only one criterion rather than all criteria, show no clear improvement.
This suggests that the LLMs benefit from the explicit inclusion of multiple criteria in their rating process and the interdependencies among criteria in the overall student rating.
Querying one criterion after another while keeping the message history, rather than asking for ratings of all criteria at once, has been shown to be effective for the medical tasks, where the number of criteria is much higher than in economics.
This directly relates to the finding that model size and the number of tokens influence the outcome, as shown in the SHAP analysis RQ3 .
Using a larger model appears to be more important than prompt design.
However, our results also show that, for the majority of tested configurations, the agreement change when replacing a human rater is negative. Figure 15 shows the prompt size, measured as the number of input and output tokens, compared with the change in inter-annotator agreement.
Note that the number of tokens can be considered only an estimate, as it comprises the prompt query, the student response text, additional features, and the LLM outputs.
Although there is a general trend indicating that agreement alphas increase with a larger number of tokens, the results also show that, for all tasks, the best IAAs are not achieved with the largest prompt.
Using an LLM to grade student answers reduces costs and enables applications such as real-time feedback, where prediction speed matters.
This depends directly on the number and size of the prompts.
blocks.zh:
虽然Alt测试显示LLM-即时配置可以取代Nudging中所有标准以及包括SUM_SCORE在内的几乎所有标准的人的评分器,但IAA的结果显示,最佳的一致是通过不同的LLM-即时组合实现的.
因此,使用一系列法学硕士课程可以最大限度地提高其效力。
然而,我们试验以标准为重点的“强化任务”提示,其中只问LLM标准,而不是所有标准,这并没有显示出明显的改进。
这表明,在整体学生评级中明确纳入多种标准以及标准之间的相互依赖性,对课程管理有所帮助。
调查一个又一个的标准,同时保留信息历史,而不是一次要求对所有标准的评级,已经证明对医疗任务是有效的,因为标准的数量远高于经济学.
这与SHAP分析显示的模型大小和符号数量影响结果的结论直接相关. RQ3 .
使用更大的模型似乎比即时设计更重要。
然而,我们的结果还表明,对于大多数经过测试的配置来说,在替换人评分器时协议的改变是否定的。 图15显示与通知人之间的协议变化相比,以输入和输出符号数量衡量的快速大小。
注意,符号的数量只能被认为是一个估计,因为它包括即时查询,学生响应文本,附加功能,以及LLM输出.
虽然总的趋势表明,协议α随着更多的符号而增加,但结果也表明,对于所有任务来说,最好的国际审计机构并没有在最迅速的情况下实现。
使用LLM来分级学生答案可以降低成本,并实现实时反馈等应用,其中预测速度很重要.
这直接取决于提示的数量和大小.

blocks.en:
The ability to use local LLMs is relevant because of AI regulations, data-protection rules, and the need for reproducibility.
Additionally, the use of proprietary LLMs can be complex or forbidden (cf. [ 67 , 28 ] ) and expensive, especially for larger reasoning models (cf. [ 74 , 43 ] ).
Therefore, given the data-protection reasons regarding the student statements, our evaluation is restricted to locally hosted, open-weight LLMs.
This conclusion is supported by our results on model parameter size and by the best-performing models based on the alt-test.
These models include a mixture of sizes and families, albeit with a focus on the Llama 3.3 70b LLM, which was also used in the most experiments, suggesting that smaller models and shorter prompts can still deliver sufficient performance.
However, larger models tend to perform better and show greater influence than prompt design.
Our results demonstrate the potential of LLM-based AES, particularly for open-weight LLMs, which have been shown to perform worse than closed LLMs in previous studies (e.g., [ 98 , 125 ] ).
We show that open state-of-the-art models can reach agreement comparable to that among our human annotators.
To this end, while proprietary LLMs might still outperform open models, the quality of the latter has increased in the recent years and now enables their use in this scenario.
The same applies to the need for fine-tuning LLMs and to the development and training of classical approaches.
Although the research by Chamieh et al. [24] , Kortemeyer [77] , Latif and Zhai [81] mentions improvements achieved through fine-tuning, our study suggests that the general knowledge of current LLMs already leads to agreement comparable to those of human annotators.
Not having to fine-tune or further train a LLM makes it more feasible for non-experts to use and develop such a rubric-based LLM-AES system.
This improves the already high level of usability enabled by the ability to control the LLM using natural language.
The results still show that, in the best case, a human rater can be replaced without lowering the agreement for about 88% of the criteria.
This finding further supports the use of self-hosted open-weight models, reducing resource utilisation, reliance on proprietary LLM providers, and issues related to privacy concerns.
blocks.zh:
由于大赦国际的条例、数据保护规则以及可复制性的必要性,使用当地有限责任公司的能力是相关的。
此外,专利有限责任公司的使用可能复杂或被禁止(参见[67、28]),而且费用昂贵,对于较大的推理模型尤其如此(参见[74、43])。
因此,鉴于学生声明的数据保护理由,我们的评估仅限于当地托管的、开放量级的有限责任公司。
这一结论得到我们关于模型参数大小的结果和基于备选测试的最佳性能模型的支持。
这些模型包括大小和家庭的混合体,尽管侧重于Llama 3.3 70b LLM,它也被用于大多数实验中,说明较小的模型和较短的提示仍然能够产生足够的性能.
然而,更大的模型往往比即时设计表现更好,并显示出更大的影响力.
我们的结果显示,基于LLM的AES具有潜力,特别是对开放量级LLMS而言,在以往的研究中,它的表现比封闭量级LLMS差(例如[98,125])。
我们表明,开放的先进模式可以与我们人类的注释者达成协议。
为此,虽然专有的有限责任公司可能仍然比开放型号好,但后者的质量近年来有所提高,现在能够在这种情况下使用。
这一点也适用于对法学硕士课程进行微调的需要以及传统方法的开发和培训。
虽然查米耶等人的研究. [24]、Kortemeyer [77]、Latif和Zhai[81]提到通过微调所取得的改进,我们的研究显示,对目前有限责任公司的一般了解已经导致达成与人类注释者类似的协议。
无需对LLM进行微调或进一步培训,非专家就更容易使用和开发这种基于数字的LLM-AES系统。
这提高了利用自然语言控制LLM的能力而已经很高的可用性。
结果仍然表明,在最好的情况下,可以不降低约88%标准的协议而替换人评分。
这一结论进一步支持使用自办的开放式模型,减少资源利用,依赖专有LLM供应商,以及与隐私有关的问题。

blocks.en:
Our results confirm that, while fine-tuning is not necessarily required, the agreement is sensitive to the prompt, as also reported by, e.g., Mansour et al. [98] , Lee et al. [83] .
However, we also observe that the SIMPLE prompts perform on a par with the more advanced ones when using the Qwen 2.5 and Nemotron LLMs.
The rubric definition in these prompts is kept very concise.
Research shows that LLMs perform worse when irrelevant information is included in the prompt [ 152 ] , and OpenAI’s recommendation for prompting state-of-the-art reasoning models is to use “straightforward prompts” [ 107 ] .
By comparison, the better-performing prompts for the Llama model are larger prompts, containing e.g., extracted textual features or training transcripts.
Considering the distribution of the top-performing models and the results of the SHAP analysis, our results indicate advantages of more complex prompts regarding most of the criteria covered in our study, similar to the findings of Huang and Wilson [65] .
blocks.zh:
我们的结果证实,虽然不一定需要微调,但如曼苏尔等人所报告,该协议对迅速情况敏感。 [98],李等人著[83].
然而,我们还注意到,SIMPLE提示在使用Quen 2.5和Nemotron LLMs时,表现与较高级的相同。
这些提示中的标题定义非常简洁。
研究显示,当不相关的信息包含在即时 [152] 中时,LLMs表现更差,OpenAI关于促进最新推理模型的建议是使用 " 直前提示 " [107].
相比之下,Llama模型表现较好的提示是较大的提示,包含例如提取的文字特征或训练笔录.
考虑到顶级模型的分布和SHAP分析的结果,我们的结果表明,在我们研究所涵盖的大多数标准方面,较复杂的提示具有优势,这与黄和威尔逊的调查结果类似[65]。

blocks.en:
We use a direct approach in LLM-based AES, where we ask the LLM for a concrete value and interpret its answer as a rating without further processing, except simple parsing or transformation.
Using the output of an LLM as input for another system – e.g., as feature generator for a classifier or another LLM – rather than relying exclusively on the LLM’s output for the rating, may improve performance.
This also removes the need for model fine-tuning but instead requires the construction of subsequent tools.
Additionally, combining the outputs of multiple LLMs can balance different model biases and compensate for errors.
See, e.g., Shibata and Miyamura [122] , Sahoo et al. [117] , Baumartz et al. [11] , who evaluate such a classifier-based method in the domain of medical education for assigning holistic ratings.
This should also be evaluated in the field of economics and for more fine-grained rubrics in future work.
blocks.zh:
我们在基于LLM的AES中采用直接的方法,我们要求LLM有具体价值,并将它的答案解释为没有进一步处理的评级,只是简单的解析或转换.
使用一个LLM的输出作为另一个系统的输入——例如作为分类器或另一个LLM的特性生成器——而不是完全依赖LLM的输出进行评级,可能会提高性能.
这也消除了对模型微调的需要,而是需要构建后续工具。
此外,合并多个有限责任管理课程的产出可以平衡不同的模型偏差并弥补错误。
例如见Shibata和Miyamura[122],Sahoo等人。 [117],Baumartz等人[11],他们在医学教育领域评价这种基于分类的方法,以便给予整体评级。
这一点也应在经济学领域加以评价,并在今后的工作中给予更多的精细评价。

blocks.en:
To assess the reproducibility of LLM-based ratings, we examined how consistent the LLMs are in their ratings ( subsection 4.7 ).
Since a temperature of 0.8 permits stochastic generation, this also indicates whether the selected model configuration results in unstable ratings.
The high average consistency suggests stability in the LLMs’ application of the rubric, which can facilitate the evaluation of known biases in LLMs and fairness in AI use (cf. [ 72 , 26 , 143 ] ).
blocks.zh:
为了评估基于LLM的评级的可复制性,我们审查了LLM的评级的一致性(第4.7分节)。
由于温度为0.8允许分层生成,这也表明所选模型配置是否导致评级不稳定.
平均高度的一致性表明有限责任公司在应用标题方面的稳定性,这有助于评价有限责任公司已知的偏见和公平使用大赦国际(参见[72、26、143])。

blocks.en:
For holistic essay scoring, earlier work by Tate et al. [128] found no statistically difference between human and ChatGPT scores.
More recent research by Emirtekin and Özarslan [45] , hovever, shows greater agreement for LLM-generated ratings on criteria that are based more on factual and definitional aspects.
They mention, that a holistic score, such as the SUM_SCORE in our study, is harder for an LLM to rate.
By contrast, for a human rater, this is an easier task than assessing analytical criteria.
The results of our study indicate that this is the case.
We report non-negative IAA changes and mostly high agreement values across all eight tasks for the best human-replacing LLM.
However, the SUM_SCORE is not predicted directly by the LLM using a prompting approach, but is calculated from the values of the other criteria.
This is consistent with how the SUM_SCORE is generated from the human ratings – human raters did not assign a holistic score directly.
This means that the quality of all other criteria factors into the outcome of the composite SUM_SCORE .
This shows that the performance differences can be smoothed out by the SUM_SCORE for both human and LLM-generated ratings.
Direct prediction should be further explored in future work, and, ideally, also compared with direct assignment by human raters.
blocks.zh:
对于整体论文评分,Tate等人先前的著作. [128]发现在统计学上人类分数和ChatGPT分数没有区别.
Hovever的Emirtekin和Özarslan最近的研究显示,对LLM生成的关于更多基于事实和定义方面的标准的评级更加一致。
他们提到,一个整体的分数,例如SUM_ 在我们的研究中 SCORE, 对LLM更难评分.
相比之下,对于一个人类的评定标准来说,这是一项比评估分析标准容易的任务。
我们的研究结果显示,情况就是这样。
我们报告所有8项任务中非负面的IAA变化和大部分高一致值,用于最佳的人取代LLM.
然而,SUM_SCORE并不是由LLM使用提示法直接预测的,而是从其他标准的值中计算出来的.
这符合SUM... SCORE来自人类的评分 – 人类的评分没有直接分配一个整体的分数.
这意味着综合SUM结果中所有其他标准因素的质量_ 萨雷.
这表明性能差异可以被SUM_SCORE平滑为人类和LLM产生的收视率.
在今后的工作中应进一步探讨直接预测,最好是与人类评估员的直接任务相比较。

blocks.en:
In total, we see that the ratings generated by the LLMs do not lower the group agreement when one human rater is replaced by one LLM for 91 of the 103 criteria.
This trend continues when we replace two humans with LLMs:
we observe a tendency toward higher agreement among LLMs than among human raters, a finding that was also reported by Frohn et al. [48] .
blocks.zh:
总的来说,我们看到,在103项标准中的91项标准中,一个人类评分器被一个LLM取代时,LLM所产生的评分不会降低群体协议.
当我们用LLMs取代两个人类时,这一趋势仍在继续:
弗罗恩等人也报告了这一结论。 [48] (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en:
Unlike the results presented by Deng et al. [38] , we do not observe a decrease in agreement for the non-Boolean criteria that we studied.
Across all categories, automatic LLM-based grading is able to produce ratings that achieve a comparable level of agreement with the human annotators for all criterion categories, i.e., regarding formal , structural and domain-specific criteria in economics and medical education.
blocks.zh:
与邓等人[38]介绍的结果不同,我们没有看到我们所研究的非布尔亚标准得到一致的降低.
在所有类别中,基于LLM的自动评级能够产生与人类注释员就所有标准类别达成可比程度的评级,即关于经济学和医学教育中正式、结构和领域特定标准的评级。

blocks.en:
Our results also show that human review is still required before employing LLM-based AES.
While simple prompts can perform adequately, the variation in IAA scores and the influence of the tasks itself suggests a validation is necessary, especially when introducing new tasks, questions, or domains into the assessments.
In practice, LLM-based scoring should therefore be validated against human ratings per task and criterion before use, since the best configuration varies.
As starting point, our results suggest larger models and prompts that include training material for economics and criterion-wise chaining for medicine.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果还表明,在使用基于LLM的AES之前,仍然需要进行人类审查。
虽然简单的提示可以充分发挥作用,但国际影响评估的分数变化和任务本身的影响表明验证是必要的,特别是在评估中引入新的任务、问题或领域时。
在实践中,基于LLM的评分在使用前应比照人类的评分和标准进行验证,因为最佳配置各不相同.
作为起点,我们的结果提出了更大的模型和提示,包括经济学培训材料和医学标准链。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en:
This study evaluates whether LLM-based systems can replace human raters in a group without reducing agreement.
We do not assess or analyse whether the LLMs produce objectively correct ratings.
We provide empirical evidence that current state-of-the-art open-weight LLMs can replace individual human annotators in assessing student responses in economics and medical education without lowering the agreement:
our results suggest preserved or increasing agreement among the top performers when replacing one or two human raters with LLM-based systems.
However, the majority of tested LLM–prompt configurations lead to decreasing agreement.
This indicates that a full replacement of all human raters is not possible and that human validation is still required.
blocks.zh:
本研究评价基于LLM的系统是否可以在不减少协议的情况下取代一个组中的人类测率.
我们不评估或分析LLMS是否产生客观正确的评级.
我们提供的经验证据表明,目前最先进的开放量级有限责任公司可以在不降低协议的情况下取代个人注释员评估学生对经济学和医学教育的反应:
我们的结果表明,在用基于LLM的系统取代一两个人测率器时,表现最好的人之间保持或加强一致。
然而,大多数经过测试的LLM-即时配置导致协议减少.
这表明不可能完全取代所有的人的评分,仍然需要人的验证.

blocks.en:
The central limitation concerns the quality of the human ratings we use for reference in our evaluation.
This is reflected by the level of disagreement measured by Krippendorff’s alpha, especially in economics, where only 5 of 31 criteria reach at least tentatively acceptable agreement, and could indicate an issue with the rubric we study.
The student statements were evaluated by two independent rater groups, which received task-specific instructions and training, including trial ratings.
However, no consolidated gold rating is available for use in our study.
Our results must therefore be interpreted as empirical evidence in the context of the observed human ratings and cannot make any assumption on the objective correctness of the LLM-generated ratings.
In particular, for criteria with low human agreement, not lowering the agreement is a weaker requirement than for criteria on which the human raters agree, and a change in agreement does not indicate whether the LLMs are better or worse.
We provide complementary measures using Cronbach’s alpha and ICC(3,k) to offer another perspective on the human rating agreement.
Additionally, the Alternative Annotator Test further provides insights into the replaceability in relation to the human rater group as a whole.
blocks.zh:
中心限制涉及我们在评价中用作参考的人类评级的质量。
Krippendorff的alph所衡量的分歧程度反映了这一点,特别是在经济学中,31个标准中只有5个至少达成了初步可以接受的一致,并且可以表明我们研究的主题存在问题。
两个独立的评分小组对学生的陈述进行了评价,并接受了具体任务的指示和培训,包括审判评分。
但是,我们的研究没有综合的黄金评级。
因此,我们的结果必须被解释为在观察到的人类评级背景下的经验证据,不能对LLM产生的评级的客观正确性作任何假设.
特别是,对于人类协议较低的标准,不降低协议的要求比人类评级人同意的标准要弱,协议的变更没有表明有限责任公司是好是坏。
我们利用Cronbach的alpha和ICC(3,k)提供补充措施,为人类评级协议提供另一种观点。
此外,备选注释员 测试进一步深入了解了整个人类评估器组的可替换性。

blocks.en:
Further limitations concern the number of student responses we analyse, as well as our restriction to a subset of tasks within each of the two disciplines.
In addition, the tasks, their length requirements, and the rubrics were designed separately for each domain as part of the original assessment, differences between the domains, e.g., in human agreement, may partly reflect these design differences and should be interpreted with caution.
blocks.zh:
进一步的限制涉及我们分析的学生答复数量,以及我们仅限于两个学科中每个学科的一组任务。
此外,任务,其长度要求,以及标题是作为原始评估的一部分,为每个域分别设计的,域之间的差异,例如在人类协议中,可能部分反映了这些设计差异,应当谨慎解释.

blocks.en:
We use only open-weight and locally hostable LLMs for data-protection reasons.
Consequently, we do not compare our results with proprietary models.
While this may seem limiting at first, the literature reviewed in section 2 suggests that proprietary models could achieve even better scores because of their larger training corpora and parameter spaces [ 125 ] .
Our results show a small to moderate correlation between model parameter size and observed IAA-based performance.
blocks.zh:
为了保护数据,我们只使用开放重量和本地可托管的LLMs。
因此,我们不把我们的结果与专利模式进行比较。
虽然这在一开始可能似乎有所限制,但第2节所审查的文献表明,专有型号可以达到更好的分数,因为它们的训练规模较大,参数空间更大[125].
我们的结果表明,模型参数大小与所观测到的IAA性能之间有小到中度的关联.

blocks.en:
Finally, we only consider criteria that do not require the LLM to use other content than the students’ responses.
Using agentic or tool-based LLM workflows for on-demand access to additional data, such as online resources, or using a RAG-based approach, should be considered in future work.
blocks.zh:
校对:Soup
在今后的工作中,应考虑利用代理或基于工具的LLM工作流程,按需获取在线资源等补充数据,或使用基于RAG的方法。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown the feasibility of using open-weight LLM-based AES for student assessments in the fields of educational economics and medicine.
Our results, which are based on real-world data from four tasks per domain, show that, for most criteria, at least one LLM–prompt configuration can replace an individual human rater without the need for fine-tuning while maintaining comparable inter-annotator agreements, as measured by Krippendorff’s alpha.
For 88%, i.e., 91 of the 103 criteria in our rubric, the agreement is not lowered when replacing one human rater, with similar results when replacing two.
At least one configuration also passes the Alternative Annotator Test with statistical significance, confirming the potential to replace at least 50% of human raters across 87% of the criteria.
These are best-case results: most tested configurations lower the agreement.
We show that the best-performing prompts and LLMs vary by criterion, however, there is no clear indication that criteria-specific prompts lead to improvements.
As no gold standard for the ratings is available, our results show agreement with the observed human raters rather than the absolute correctness of the LLM ratings.
Performance is associated more with model and prompt size than with prompt design.
There is no visible difference in LLM performance across the three criteria categories; the models are able to assign ratings similar to those of the human raters for formal , structural , and domain-knowledge criteria across both domains.
While LLMs avoid the individual effects of the human raters they replace, they introduce their own biases into the ratings.
However, using automated methods can lead to more stable assessments and enable faster processes, including real-time feedback to students while they are writing.
Human validation is still needed to ground LLM-based AES systems during development.
Together, these findings suggest the use of LLM ensembles to benefit from higher top performances per criterion and to mitigate model and prompt biases.
blocks.zh:
我们已表明,在教育经济学和医学领域使用开放量的LLM AES进行学生评估是可行的。
我们的成果基于每个领域四个任务的真实世界数据,这些结果显示,对于大多数标准来说,至少一个LLM-即时配置可以取代个人的评分器,而不需要微调,同时保持可比的注释者之间的协议,正如克里彭多夫的α所衡量的那样.
88%,即我们标题中的103个标准中的91个,在替换一个人评分器时协议不降低,在替换两个时结果相似.
至少有一个配置还通过了具有统计意义的替代注解测试,证实在87%的标准中,至少可以替换50%的人评分。
这些是最好的结果:大多数测试过的配置降低协议.
我们显示,表现最佳的提示和有限责任协议因标准而异,但没有明确迹象表明,具体标准的提示导致改进。
由于评分没有金本位标准,我们的结果表明与被观察的人评分一致,而不是LLM评分绝对正确.
性能与模型和即时大小相关,而非即时设计.
在三个标准类别中,LLM的性能没有明显差别;这些模型能够为这两个领域的正规、结构和域知识标准分配与人类评级者相似的评级。
虽然LLMS避免了他们所取代的人类评分器的个人影响,但是它们却在评分中引入了自己的偏见.
然而,使用自动化方法可以导致更稳定的评估,并促成更快的流程,包括在学生写作时向学生提供实时反馈.
在开发期间,仍然需要进行人类验证以建立基于LLM的AES系统。
这些调查结果表明,应利用LLM群集,从每项标准的较高业绩中获益,并减少模型和迅速的偏差。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
The study uses written statements produced by participants in an educational setting, as well as rating data generated by human raters.
As part of a multicenter research project, this study was approved by the ethics committee of LMU (approval reference no. 23-0688).
We received the dataset in pseudonymised form from the project partners as part of an existing educational assessment in the context of the CORE project.
Although we had access to the original written texts, all personally identifiable information had been removed before we received the data.
All processing of student statements took place on local infrastructure.

该研究使用参与者在教育环境中制作的书面声明以及人类评分员生成的评分数据.
作为多中心研究项目的一部分,本研究得到了LMU伦理委员会的批准(批准参考号:23-0688)。
我们收到了项目伙伴以假名形式提供的数据集,这是在CORE项目范围内进行的现有教育评估的一部分。
虽然我们可以得到原始的书面文本,但在收到数据之前,所有个人可识别的信息都已删除。
所有学生声明的处理都在当地基础设施上进行。

blocks.en: Appendix F Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: 附录F 提示模板

blocks.en:
This appendix shows one example template for each of the prompt variants of the main study  using the task Breathing .
Within a variant, the templates of the other tasks differ mainly in the criteria they list.
All templates of both studies, for every prompt variant and task, including the criteria-specific prompts of the Nudging-only study, are provided as supplementary material.
The templates are reproduced as used in the experiments.
The task texts, scenarios, criterion definitions, and scale descriptions are replaced by placeholders (e.g., {TASK} ), as these materials were developed as part of the original assessment and are not publicly available.
Their content is summarised in subsection 3.1 .
For data-protection reasons, the same applies to all content derived from students, i.e., the student statement, the text features, and the transcript of the rater training.
Each template consists of a sequence of messages with the roles system , human , and assistant .
For prompts with multiple requests, e.g., the CHAIN prompts, {LLM_ANSWER} marks the position of the model’s previous answer in the message history, which is fully retained.
